title: Euro-Step Both Directions
description: Players rehearse the two-step lateral euro-step move to avoid a defender at the rim, practising it toward both the left and right side.

content.objective: Use a two-step lateral move to avoid a defender's position before finishing at the rim.
content.setup: Players attack from the elbow with a ball, approaching the lane at an angle.
instructions: Drive into the lane and plant the first step going one direction.
Take a second step laterally the opposite way, moving the body away from the imaginary defender.
Finish with a soft touch off the backboard using the hand furthest from the defender's side.
Repeat starting from the opposite elbow, mirroring the move.
coachingPoints: Keep the ball protected on the side away from the defender at every step.
Stay low through both steps for balance.
Finish with touch, not force, once clear of the defender.
commonMistakes: Taking three steps instead of the legal two.
Exposing the ball on the defender's side during the move.
Bringing the ball down low where it can be knocked away.
content.safety: Watch for other players when driving across the lane at speed.
